title: CSM-SR: Conditional Structure-Informed Multi-Scale Super-Resolution GAN
summary: Pioneering super-resolution framework for microscopy and nanoscience imaging using hierarchical multi-scale learning and adaptive feature fusion to achieve unprecedented image quality.
problem: Scientific imaging applications require ultra-high resolution reconstruction while preserving critical structural details. Traditional super-resolution methods achieve only basic pixel enhancement, losing fine-grained features crucial for nanoscience and biomedical research.
solution: Developed a novel deep learning architecture integrating encoder-based feature conditioning, multi-scale discriminator design, and a custom Semantic Structural Loss (SSL) function — all within a three-stage pipeline designed for scientific image fidelity.
achievements: 3.5 dB PSNR improvement over state-of-the-art methods
38.79 PSNR / 0.978 SSIM / 0.178 LPIPS on SEM datasets (2.8 dB PSNR gain over competitors)
Outperformed EDSR, ESRGAN, SwinIR, and HMANet on Set5, Set14, BSD100 benchmarks
20% SSIM increase and 20% LPIPS decrease vs. competitors

architecture.title: Architecture Details
architecture.content: Three-stage pipeline: (1) Feature conditioning via encoder that extracts structural priors from low-resolution input; (2) Multi-scale generation with hierarchical upsampling; (3) Multi-scale discriminator enforcing both global coherence and local structural accuracy.

loss.title: Semantic Structural Loss (SSL)
loss.content: Custom hybrid loss combining perceptual loss (VGG features), contextual loss (non-local similarity), and a novel structural loss term that penalizes deviation from domain-specific structural priors. This three-component formulation is the core innovation of CSM-SR.

contribution.title: Research Contributions
contribution.content: Novel SSL formulation applicable beyond super-resolution; multi-scale discriminator design that can be adapted to other generative tasks in scientific imaging; open-source benchmarks on SEM and nanoscience datasets.
